opening_title: ExceptionGroup traceback of session fixture unlimitedly grows from test to test

expected_outcome.rationale: A session fixture raising ExceptionGroup produces tracebacks that grow across tests. #12203 reports missing log records when a fixture raises; these share fixture and exception context but differ in symptom and requested remedy. A package list, OS version and runnable example are supplied. The prose/package list says pytest 8.1.1 while the pasted run says 8.0.0; this inconsistency warrants clarification but is not absence of the combined version detail.
